mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Conditions are clear at Firemans Park with a temperature of 74 degrees. We are looking at an overnight low of 58 degrees with no rain predicted. If you look up at 9:35 PM, you can catch the International Space Station traveling from the direction of Cross Plains in the northwest toward Oregon in the southeast, passing almost directly overhead.

For city news, the I Voted sticker contest has officially closed its submission period for K-12 students. Community members can cast their votes for their favorite designs between July 28 and August 7 to determine the winners who will have their art featured on official stickers in November.

Today is packed with options including Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park at Century School Park, and trivia at Hop Haus. Looking ahead, tomorrow brings live music to Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market this Saturday.
In a recent report, on July 13, the Verona Police Department assisted with a vehicle that had become stuck on a large rock, resulting in the driver being arrested for an O-W-I.
Make sure to stop by for the Really Reese's flavor of the day. The store is open until 10 PM, so you still have plenty of time to get your fix before they wrap up for the night.
